+"""Command-line interface for the notes app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import List, Optional, TextIO
+
+from app.notes import Note, NoteNotFoundError, NoteStore, default_store_path
+
+
+def _format_note(note: Note, full: bool = False) -> str:
+    header = f"[{note.id}] {note.title}  (updated {note.updated})"
+    if full:
+        return f"{header}\n{note.body}" if note.body else header
+    return header
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="notes", description="A simple command-line notes app."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--file",
+        type=Path,
+        default=None,
+        help="path to the notes store (default: $NOTES_FILE or ~/.notes.json)",
+    )
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    p_add = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a new note")
+    p_add.add_argument("title", help="note title")
+    p_add.add_argument("-b", "--body", default="", help="note body text")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    p_show = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note in full")
+    p_show.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_edit = sub.add_parser("edit", help="change a note's title and/or body")
+    p_edit.add_argument("id", type=int)
+    p_edit.add_argument("-t", "--title", default=None)
+    p_edit.add_argument("-b", "--body", default=None)
+
+    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note")
+    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_search = sub.add_parser("search", help="search titles and bodies")
+    p_search.add_argument("query")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+def main(
+    argv: Optional[List[str]] = None, out: TextIO = sys.stdout, err: TextIO = sys.stderr
+) -> int:
+    parser = build_parser()
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    store = NoteStore(args.file if args.file is not None else default_store_path())
+
+    try:
+        if args.command == "add":
+            note = store.add(args.title, args.body)
+            print(f"added note {note.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "list":
+            notes = store.list()
+            if not notes:
+                print("no notes", file=out)
+            for note in notes:
+                print(_format_note(note), file=out)
+        elif args.command == "show":
+            print(_format_note(store.get(args.id), full=True), file=out)
+        elif args.command == "edit":
+            if args.title is None and args.body is None:
+                parser.error("edit requires --title and/or --body")
+            note = store.edit(args.id, title=args.title, body=args.body)
+            print(f"updated note {note.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "delete":
+            note = store.delete(args.id)
+            print(f"deleted note {note.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "search":
+            matches = store.search(args.query)
+            if not matches:
+                print("no matches", file=out)
+            for note in matches:
+                print(_format_note(note), file=out)
+    except (NoteNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=err)
+        return 1
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Storage layer for the notes app: a list of notes persisted as JSON."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import List, Optional
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(LookupError):
+    """Raised when a note id does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Note:
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    body: str
+    created: str
+    updated: str
+
+
+def default_store_path() -> Path:
+    """Return the store path from $NOTES_FILE, or ~/.notes.json by default."""
+    env = os.environ.get("NOTES_FILE")
+    if env:
+        return Path(env).expanduser()
+    return Path.home() / ".notes.json"
+
+
+def _now() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+
+
+class NoteStore:
+    """A JSON-file backed collection of notes."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: Path | str):
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    # -- persistence -------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _load(self) -> List[Note]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note(**item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: List[Note]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        data = json.dumps([asdict(n) for n in notes], indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
+        # Write atomically so a crash mid-write cannot corrupt the store.
+        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=str(self.path.parent), prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp"
+        )
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                fh.write(data + "\n")
+            os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+        except BaseException:
+            if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                os.unlink(tmp)
+            raise
+
+    # -- operations --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def list(self) -> List[Note]:
+        """Return all notes, ordered by id."""
+        return sorted(self._load(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(f"no note with id {note_id}")
+
+    def add(self, title: str, body: str = "") -> Note:
+        title = title.strip()
+        if not title:
+            raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        now = _now()
+        note = Note(id=next_id, title=title, body=body, created=now, updated=now)
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+
+    def edit(
+        self, note_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, body: Optional[str] = None
+    ) -> Note:
+        notes = self._load()
+        for note in notes:
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                if title is not None:
+                    title = title.strip()
+                    if not title:
+                        raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+                    note.title = title
+                if body is not None:
+                    note.body = body
+                note.updated = _now()
+                self._save(notes)
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(f"no note with id {note_id}")
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        notes = self._load()
+        for i, note in enumerate(notes):
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                removed = notes.pop(i)
+                self._save(notes)
+                return removed
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(f"no note with id {note_id}")
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> List[Note]:
+        """Case-insensitive substring search over title and body."""
+        q = query.lower()
+        return [n for n in self.list() if q in n.title.lower() or q in n.body.lower()]

+"""Command-line interface for the notes app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.notes import Note, NoteNotFoundError, NotesStore
+
+DEFAULT_PATH = Path.home() / ".notes.json"
+
+
+def _default_path() -> Path:
+    env = os.environ.get("NOTES_FILE")
+    return Path(env) if env else DEFAULT_PATH
+
+
+def _format_note(note: Note, full: bool = False) -> str:
+    header = f"[{note.id}] {note.title}" if note.title else f"[{note.id}]"
+    if full:
+        return f"{header}\n{note.created_at} (updated {note.updated_at})\n\n{note.body}"
+    first_line = note.body.splitlines()[0] if note.body else ""
+    return f"{header} {first_line}".rstrip()
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="notes", description="A simple command-line notes app."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--file",
+        type=Path,
+        default=None,
+        help="path to the notes file (default: $NOTES_FILE or ~/.notes.json)",
+    )
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    add = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a new note")
+    add.add_argument("body", help="note text")
+    add.add_argument("-t", "--title", default="", help="optional title")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    show = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note in full")
+    show.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    edit = sub.add_parser("edit", help="replace the text of a note")
+    edit.add_argument("id", type=int)
+    edit.add_argument("body", help="new note text")
+
+    delete = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note")
+    delete.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    search = sub.add_parser("search", help="find notes containing text")
+    search.add_argument("query")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None, *, store: NotesStore | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = build_parser()
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    if store is None:
+        path = args.file if args.file is not None else _default_path()
+        store = NotesStore(path)
+
+    try:
+        return _dispatch(args, store)
+    except NoteNotFoundError as exc:
+        print(f"error: no note with id {exc.args[0]}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+
+def _print_notes(notes: list[Note], empty_message: str) -> None:
+    if not notes:
+        print(empty_message)
+    for note in notes:
+        print(_format_note(note))
+
+
+def _dispatch(args: argparse.Namespace, store: NotesStore) -> int:
+    if args.command == "add":
+        note = store.add(args.body, title=args.title)
+        print(f"added note {note.id}")
+    elif args.command == "list":
+        _print_notes(store.list(), "no notes")
+    elif args.command == "show":
+        print(_format_note(store.get(args.id), full=True))
+    elif args.command == "edit":
+        note = store.update(args.id, args.body)
+        print(f"updated note {note.id}")
+    elif args.command == "delete":
+        store.delete(args.id)
+        print(f"deleted note {args.id}")
+    elif args.command == "search":
+        _print_notes(store.search(args.query), "no matches")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Core notes storage: a small JSON-file-backed note store."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, List
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note ID does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Note:
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    body: str
+    created_at: str
+    updated_at: str
+
+
+def _now() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+
+
+class NotesStore:
+    """Stores notes in a JSON file. The file is created on first write."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    def _load(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return {"next_id": 1, "notes": []}
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            return json.load(fh)
+
+    def _save(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        # Write atomically so a crash cannot leave a half-written file.
+        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=self.path.parent, prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp"
+        )
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                json.dump(data, fh, indent=2)
+            os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+        except BaseException:
+            if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                os.unlink(tmp)
+            raise
+
+    def _notes_from(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> List[Note]:
+        return [Note(**item) for item in data["notes"]]
+
+    def add(self, body: str, title: str = "") -> Note:
+        body = body.strip()
+        if not body:
+            raise ValueError("note body must not be empty")
+        data = self._load()
+        now = _now()
+        note = Note(
+            id=int(data["next_id"]),
+            title=title.strip(),
+            body=body,
+            created_at=now,
+            updated_at=now,
+        )
+        data["notes"].append(asdict(note))
+        data["next_id"] = note.id + 1
+        self._save(data)
+        return note
+
+    def list(self) -> List[Note]:
+        return sorted(self._notes_from(self._load()), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        for note in self._notes_from(self._load()):
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def update(self, note_id: int, body: str) -> Note:
+        body = body.strip()
+        if not body:
+            raise ValueError("note body must not be empty")
+        data = self._load()
+        for item in data["notes"]:
+            if item["id"] == note_id:
+                item["body"] = body
+                item["updated_at"] = _now()
+                self._save(data)
+                return Note(**item)
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> None:
+        data = self._load()
+        remaining = [item for item in data["notes"] if item["id"] != note_id]
+        if len(remaining) == len(data["notes"]):
+            raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+        data["notes"] = remaining
+        self._save(data)
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> List[Note]:
+        needle = query.lower()
+        return [
+            n
+            for n in self.list()
+            if needle in n.title.lower() or needle in n.body.lower()
+        ]
